messages:
maya: quick one — where's the canonical saved search for combined 429 + 5xx errors broken down by org, model and route across regions? I need it to drive a new alert but want to avoid counting client retries.
sam: there's no single canonical one iirc. i made a quick query yesterday that might work: 
```
(service:inference) AND (status:429 OR status:[500 TO 599]) AND NOT message:/retrying request/
| parse org_id, model, route, region
| stats count() by org_id, model, route, region, status
```
use that as a saved search and add the tag `sre/alerts` so alerts can pick it up.
leo: fwiw, in prod eu we're seeing a lot of 429s from a bursty partner — we should filter by user_agent or source_ip to avoid paging on expected partner throttling.
nina: +1. also suggest adding a rate-limited baseline: alert when error_rate > 3% over 5m AND total_requests > 1000 to reduce noise. default 1% pages too often for low-traffic orgs.
maya: thanks. can someone paste the exact saved-search JSON or share the dashboard link? i'll wire up the alert (pager duty) once saved.
sam: pasted an example saved search name we can use: `eng-sre/5xx-429-by-org-model-route` — when creating it set `scope: all-regions` and a description: "Counts 429 and 5xx by org, model, route; excludes internal retries".
leo: dashboard link for visualization: https://console.redwood/infrastructure/dashboards/alerts/5xx-429-heatmap (use the `model` and `route` breakdown widgets).
ops-bot: Saved-search created: eng-sre/5xx-429-by-org-model-route by sam at 1779005487 :white_check_mark:
maya: perfect. two small asks: 1) can we add `org_name` lookup (from org_id) so alert messages show human names, and 2) exclude known partner IP ranges (i'll paste list in a follow-up).
nina: i can add the lookup mapping to the saved search pipeline. paste the CSV and i'll finish.
maya: CSV pasted in thread (see pinned file). also leaving note: when we wire alert, let's have a warning-level (slack) at 1.5% and page at 3% sustained for 5m.
sam: sounds good. i'll update alert playbook with runbook links and add the saved search to the `sre/alerts` folder so other teams can reuse. :thumbsup:
leo: one more: please include `status:429` and `status:503` separately in the dashboard so product can triage differently.
maya: added to the ticket: https://tickets.redwood/INF-8243 — cc @product-observability
ima: (just chiming in) if you want, i can add a kibana-style permalink in the saved search metadata so the product folks can open the exact filtered view.
maya: awesome, thanks everyone. i'll wire PD escalation once sam confirms the saved search and runbook are linked.
